description: Synthetic test reports. 'cases' should find a past incident: 'expected' lists every record that describes the same underlying problem. 'low_keyword' marks reports written to share almost no words with the matching records. 'negatives' have no true match; 'look-alike' ones share equipment or wording with a record ('looks_like') but are a different problem. Showing any match for a negative is a false alarm.

cases.query: Paper web keeps breaking right after the second press and the felt looks glazed.
Slimy deposits in the white water system and holes showing up in the finished paper.
Basis weight swinging and the headbox pressure will not settle.
Tablets failing friability because the top layer peels off.
Paper tears near the squeezing rolls and the blanket underneath seems clogged up.
Pills come out soft and their tops pop off.
Microbes grew on a dish placed beside the hole where workers put their hands into the sterile enclosure.
The storage room for long-term product tests got too damp over the weekend.
Wet streaks across the sheet at the reel and a couple of dryer cans in the third group are cold.
Knocking inside the drying cylinders and damp bands across the web; water seems to be collecting in them.
Calender doctor blade vibrating and leaving bar marks across the paper.
Paper strength going down, burst and tensile low, freeness above target even though refining energy is the same.
Finished reels slide out like a telescope during shipping and feel squashy at the edges.
Paper keeps snapping at the reel when we change over to an empty spool.
PM2 first press roll bearing running hot with a vibration alarm.
Holes repeating at the same interval as the wire length, no sign of slime.
Heavy streak at one cross-machine position on the basis weight profile; slice actuator not moving.
Water dripping from the hood above the dryers onto the web, causing wet spots and breaks.
Vacuum pump tripped, couch vacuum lost and the sheet comes out of the press wetter.
TOC high on the purified water return loop, conductivity fine.
Organic carbon readings in our process water creeping past the alert level; the ultraviolet unit has a warning light.
Blister leak test failing, dye getting into the pockets.
Bowie-Dick test failed on the steriliser this morning.
Air-removal check on the steam sterilizer shows a pale patch in the middle of the indicator sheet.
Pressure between the corridor and the airlock dropped, BMS alarm, air handler airflow low.
Tablet weights all over the place on TP-02 but hardness is fine.
Tablets sticking to the punches and the logo is filling in.
Stability chamber too warm, humidity normal, compressor keeps cycling on and off.
Torn filter bag in the fluid bed dryer, powder in the exhaust.
The 2 to 8 degree cold room hit 10 degrees after someone left the door open.

negatives.query: Forklift battery charger tripped the breaker in the finished goods warehouse.
Canteen coffee machine leaking water onto the floor.
Hydraulic oil leaking from the loading cylinder on the third press of PM2.
Breaks at the size press because the starch cooker failed and the starch came out too thick.
Wire pit overflowing onto the floor after its level transmitter failed high.
Fan pump mechanical seal leaking water onto the basement floor.
Winder slitter knives dull, ragged edges on the slit rolls.
Punch tip broke on tablet press TP-02 and a metal fragment was found in tablets.
Product A tablets too hard and dissolution is slow.
Stoppers popping up on vials after capping on aseptic filling line 1.
Light intensity in the photostability cabinet out of range.
Purified water loop pump tripped and loop flow was lost for 15 minutes.
Autoclave AC-2 cycle aborted on low steam supply pressure from the boiler house.
Foil splice broke on blister line BL-3 and the line stopped.
Label printer on packaging line 2 printing faded batch numbers.
